title: ChronoDossier: Long-Form Personas as Temporal Memory Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.25407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agents rely on stored records to recover a person's state as facts change. Reliable answers depend on how facts are recorded, retrieved, and presented to the reader. We treat a long-form persona dossier as a memory representation of a known latent state, an invariant identity plus a timeline of facts, routines, and decision rules tied to life phases. We present ChronoDossier, a benchmark of 311 synthetic dossiers of 1k-10k words written by seven generators from dated timelines. Intrinsic metrics evaluate the records against their intended states; extrinsic metrics test recovery by five readers on a seeded 32-persona GPT-5.1 panel balanced across lengths (520 rated turns per condition). The linked states, records, evidence packets, and answers support tests of construction and evidence delivery. translated_title: ChronoDossier：作为时序记忆表征的长篇人物档案
translated_abstract: 长时程智能体依赖存储的记录来在事实发生变化时恢复一个人的状态。可靠的回答取决于事实如何被记录、检索以及呈现给读者。我们将长篇人物档案视为对已知潜在状态的一种记忆表征，即一个不变的身份，加上与人生阶段相关联的事实、例行事务和决策规则的时间线。我们提出了ChronoDossier，这是一个包含311份合成档案的基准，每份档案长度为1千至1万词，由七个生成器根据带日期的时间线撰写而成。内在指标根据预期状态评估这些记录；外在指标通过五个读取器在一个种子化的、跨越不同长度均衡分布的32人设GPT-5.1面板上测试状态恢复能力（每个条件520个评级轮次）。相互关联的状态、记录、证据包和答案支持对档案构建与证据传递的测试。在一项上下文压力对照实验中，限定标签范围的写作器输入消除了检测到的范围外锚点内容复制。在……上编写的冻结问题（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ChronoDossier基准，将长篇人物档案视为时序记忆表征，利用311份合成档案和内在与外在双重指标，评估长时程智能体在事实随时间变化时记录和恢复人物潜在状态的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ChronoDossier, a benchmark of 311 synthetic long-form persona dossiers that treats such dossiers as temporal memory representations, evaluating how well long-horizon agents record and recover a person's evolving latent state as facts change over time.
